subject: Insurance
title: Keith Richards' Hands
description: A fast breakdown of Keith Richards' Hands for builders.

hook.text: Keith Richards insured his hands for $1.6 million. Without them, the Rolling Stones lose their signature guitar sound.

buildup.text: Musicians face unique risks: repetitive strain, stage accidents, even overzealous fans grabbing them.

discovery.text: Guitar players insure hands, vocalists insure throats, pianists insure fingers.

twist.text: Richards' lifestyle of excess made his premiums astronomical. Insurers price behavior, not just anatomy.

climax.text: For professional musicians, a hand injury isn't medical—it's economic. The policy protects income, not health.

punchline.text: $1.6 million hands. Rock and roll needs body-part insurance.

quiz.question: What did Keith Richards insure and why?
options: His hands because they produce the Stones' sound
